extension.summary: Track and watch your Trakt next episodes, and search TV shows and movies, via Real-Debrid.
extension.description: Episode Tracker focuses on one job: your Trakt "next up" episodes. It pulls the next unwatched episode for every show you are progressing through on Trakt.tv, scrapes torrent sources with the CocoScrapers module, resolves cached links through Real-Debrid, plays them, and scrobbles your progress back to Trakt. Requires the script.module.cocoscrapers module, a Trakt.tv account, and a Real-Debrid or TorBox subscription.
extension.disclaimer: This addon does not host, provide, or link to any content. It is a metadata and playback front-end for services the user independently subscribes to (Trakt.tv and Real-Debrid) and third-party scraper modules the user independently installs. The author is not responsible for the content accessed through it, and is in no way affiliated with Kodi, Team Kodi, or the XBMC Foundation.
extension.news: v1.7.0 - Resume where you left off using your Trakt position, an offer to play the next episode when one finishes, and the option to hide a show from Next Episodes.
